paragraphs: Jacob son of Isaac of Beit Gufnin.
He is mentioned in Tosefta Ohalot, chapter 18: he testified together with R' Judah son of Jacob of Beit Gevriya concerning Caesarea, etc.[^1]

notes.text: פ״יח gives chapter 18, without a freshly checked edition. Gufnin/Gevriya remain distinct place forms and conventional vowels, without canonical location binding. על is contextually concerning Caesarea, without supplying the unquoted testimony’s precise legal content. Source וכו׳ stays etc. Both full patronymics and joint testimony remain; the headed Jacob is untitled and Judah’s personal title R'.
